correctness.rationale: The finite enumeration has the correct universe (all 2^15 masks), click adjacency (the incident edges at a uniform in/out vertex only), connectivity, and distance conventions. A source-to-sink move cannot introduce a directed cycle, and the inverse sink move gives the same undirected edge. Vertex relabelings and arrow reversal preserve acyclicity and legal flips. An independent run of /workspace/branches/e66f836f-f1ef-4704-a45b-8bd0397d3206/independent_click_census.py exhaustively reproduced 16,680 states, 28,140 edges, 704 components, all eight (order, multiplicity, edges, radius, diameter) rows, all nine S5-orbit rows, and the reversal transposition on the two order-21 orbits alone; output is in independent_click_census.out beside the script. Thus equality of order implies isomorphism via relabeling and, only for order 21, possibly reversal. This is a finite result for this graph; the frozen uploaded verifier was inspected, not executed.
